verdict.rationale: React's docs explicitly recommend official starter frameworks like Next.js and React Router for building a full app, and react.dev has a 'Quick Start' section, but the evidence never shows React itself shipping a first-party scaffolding CLI (e.g. create-react-app is not mentioned) — it defers scaffolding entirely to third-party frameworks. missing for 10: an official React CLI/starter template documented in first-party sources, hands-on confirmation of a quick multi-minute scaffold experience.
